properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 12 at 6:28PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 628 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles south of St Petersburg, or 23 miles southeast of Sterling,
moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
St Petersburg and Highland Center.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 12 at 6:20PM MDT until August 12 at 6:45PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 620 PM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 8
miles east of Peetz to 7 miles south of Iliff, or along a line from
28 miles northeast of Sterling to 7 miles east of Sterling, moving
east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Fleming, Crook, Proctor, Twin Buttes and Reiradon Hill.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 12 at 6:19PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
At 618 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 4 miles south of Lone Star to 5 miles northeast
of Yuma to 15 miles south of Eckley. Movement was northeast at 20
mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Strong thunderstorms will be near...
Eckley around 630 PM MDT.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 6:09PM MDT until August 12 at 9:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 915 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 609 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Westplains.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 5:51PM MDT until August 12 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible.

* WHERE...Gold Mountain burn scar in Ouray County, Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Storms producing excessive rainfall are developing
upstream and near the Gold Mountain Burn Scar. Excessive rain is
possible and could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 551 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms south of the burn scar. Flash flooding and debris
flows remain possible in Cutler and Dexter Creek drainages.
- Cutler and Dexter Creek drainages is the most likely place to
experience minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dexter and Cutler Creek and nearby areas along Highway 550
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 5:23PM MDT until August 12 at 7:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Debris from mudslide and flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern San Miguel County along Highway 145 between
Sawpit and Placerville...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Water and debris flows over along Highway 145 between
Sawpit and Placerville or expected to begin shortly.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 523 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in Highway 145 near Sawpit and Placerville. Between 0.1
and 0.2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Highway 145 near Sawpit and Placerville is the most likely place
to experience minor flooding. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.2
to 0.4 inches are expected over the area. This additional rain
will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sawpit, Fall Creek and Placerville.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 12 at 5:09PM MDT until August 12 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small streams flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is occurring. Reports of mudslide on Interstate 70 near
Dowds Junction.

* WHERE...East Central Eagle County in west central Colorado, along
Interstate 70 from mile marker 165 to 175...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding over roadways and Interstate 70 is imminent or
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 506 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing in the warned area. Between
0.5 and 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Avon, Vail, Minturn, Edwards, Eagle-Vail and Dowd.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
